```{r}
#| message: false
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap) 
library(here) # file path management
library(stars)
```

## Background


## Data
VIIRS data is distributed through NASA’s [Level-1 and Atmospheric Archive & Distribution System Distributed Active Archive Center (LAADS DAAC)](https://ladsweb.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov/).

We used [Geofabrik’s download sites](https://download.geofabrik.de/) to retrieve a shapefile of all highways in Texas and prepared a Geopackage (.gpkg file) containing just the subset of roads that intersect the Houston metropolitan area.

We can also obtain building data from OpenStreetMap. We again downloaded from Geofabrick and prepared a GeoPackage containing only houses in the Houston metropolitan area.


```{r}
# Read VIIRS tiles for February 7, 2021
pre_5 <- read_stars(
  here::here("data", "VNP46A1", "VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif")
)

pre_6 <- read_stars(
  here::here("data", "VNP46A1", "VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif")
)

# Read VIIRS tiles for February 16, 2021
post_5 <- read_stars(
  here::here("data", "VNP46A1", "VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif")
)

post_6 <- read_stars(
  here::here("data", "VNP46A1", "VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif")
)

pre <- st_mosaic(pre_5, pre_6)
post <- st_mosaic(post_5, post_6)

# Read motorway roads only
roads <- read_sf(
  here::here("data", "gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg"),
  query = "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'"
)

# Read likely residential buildings only
houses <- read_sf(
  here::here("data", "gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg"),
  query = "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
         WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
         OR type IN ('residential','apartments','house','static_caravan','detached')"
)
```

```{r}
plot(pre)
```


```{r}
plot(post)
```


```{r}
blackout_mask <- pre - post
```


```{r}
# Set all cells with values greater than 200 to NA
blackout_mask[blackout_mask<200] <- NA

```

```{r}
# Vectorizing 

blackout_sf <- st_as_sf(blackout_mask) |>
  st_make_valid()
```

```{r}
# Cropping blackout mask to Houston area
blackout_houston <- st_crop(
  blackout_sf,
  xmin = -96.5,
  ymin = 29,
  xmax = -94.5,
  ymax = 30.5
)
```


```{r}
blackout_houston <-st_transform(blackout_houston, st_crs("EPSG:3083"))
```


```{r}
st_crs(blackout_houston)
```

```{r}
st_crs(roads)
```

```{r}
# Transform roads to match blackout CRS
roads <- st_transform(
  roads,
  st_crs(blackout_houston)
)
```

```{r}
road_buffer <- st_buffer(roads, dist = 200)
```


```{r}
road_union <- st_union(road_buffer)
```


```{r}
blackout_houston_nr <- st_difference(
  blackout_houston,
  road_union
)
```

```{r}
st_crs(blackout_houston)
```


```{r}
st_crs(roads)
```


```{r}
plot(blackout_houston_nr)
```


```{r}
st_crs(houses)
```

```{r}
# Transform roads to match blackout CRS
houses <- st_transform(
  houses,
  st_crs(blackout_houston)
)
```


```{r}
# st_filter with st_intersects (the default predicate)
houses_blackouts <- st_filter(houses, blackout_houston_nr)|> 
  st_geometry()
```


```{r}
plot(houses_blackouts)
```

```{r}
bo_houston <-
  tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap", zoom = 9, alpha = 0.9) +
  tm_shape(blackout_houston_nr) +
  tm_polygons()
bo_houston
```

```{r}
hb_houston <-
  tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap", zoom = 9, alpha = 0.9) +
  tm_shape(houses_blackouts) +
  tm_polygons()
hb_houston
```
